title: Without WebGL the landing has no field and the hero stands on its own
intent: A browser with no WebGL gets no field and no fallback image: data-field is off, and the hero heading, copy and install commands are present, fit the page and raise no error.
preconditions: WebGL is removed from the browser context before the page loads, so a canvas offers no WebGL context.

steps.expect: The hero's data-field becomes off, and the hero holds no canvas.
Its heading, copy and install commands are visible, the document fits within one pixel, and the page logged no error.
